title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
title_zh: SkillLifeBench：跨智能体技能生命周期的安全性基准测试

paragraphs.en: Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility joint success from 49.35% with logs and metadata to 65.58%. A deterministic execution-consistency rule reaches 64.94% with higher benign utility, while full restoration reaches 69.48%. Lifecycle tasks distinguish models with similar runtime scores, and execution evidence improves recovery.

paragraphs.en: Web agents use reusable skills to access email, cloud storage, and Web APIs ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2023 ) . A skill packages reusable instructions or executable functions for an agent. Stale or altered skills can expose private data or trigger unauthorized actions, making lifecycle integrity a Web security and privacy concern. Evaluation measures task completion and adherence to authorized data access, destinations, and state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 网络智能体使用可复用的技能来访问电子邮件、云存储和网络 API（Xu and Yan, 2026; Ling et al., 2026; Yao et al., 2023）。 技能为智能体打包了可复用的指令或可执行的函数。 过时或被篡改的技能可能泄露隐私数据或触发未授权的操作，使生命周期完整性成为一个网络安全与隐私问题。 评估衡量任务完成情况，以及对已授权的数据访问、目标地址和状态变更的遵守程度。

sents.zh: 评估衡量任务完成情况，以及对已授权的数据访问、目标地址和状态变更的遵守程度。

paragraphs.en: An agent can deliver a correct report while copying data without authorization, or select a repaired skill while a saved execution reference ( handle ) still invokes the vulnerable previous version (Figure 2 ). Existing benchmarks cover attacks through skill content, composition, persistence, and updates ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Badhe and Tiwari, 2026 ) . Outputs and version records alone cannot establish which code ran or whether its actions were authorized. Evaluation must link calls to executed code, check task completion and unauthorized effects separately, and test agents’ version, permission, and workflow choices.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可能在未经授权复制数据的同时交付一份正确的报告，或者在选择已修复技能时，仍被保存的执行引用（句柄）调用存在漏洞的旧版本（图 2）。 现有基准涵盖了通过技能内容、组合、持久化与更新发起的攻击（Debenedetti et al., 2024；Zhuang et al., 2026；Xie et al., 2026；Liao et al., 2026；Ning et al., 2026；Mao et al., 2026；Badhe and Tiwari, 2026）。 仅凭输出和版本记录无法确定实际运行的是哪段代码，也无法确定其操作是否经过授权。 评估必须将调用与被执行的代码关联起来，分别检查任务完成情况与未授权影响，并测试智能体在版本、权限与工作流上的选择。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SkillLifeBench , with 388 paired cases spanning the skill lifecycle. Each pair holds the user request and authorization fixed while changing an implementation, interface, runtime response, composition, or version. Two paired decision tracks evaluate 14 models: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks (Table 2 ). On lifecycle tasks, agents can inspect and change skill state or use available tools directly. Task and attack-goal checks define joint success: fulfilling the request without achieving the registered attack goal. Prescribed-call cases measure implementation behavior under a fixed invocation; the two decision tracks measure model choices with complete task checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SkillLifeBench，包含 388 个贯穿技能生命周期的成对案例。 每对案例保持用户请求与授权不变，仅改变实现、接口、运行时响应、组合方式或版本。 两条成对决策轨道评估 14 个模型：89 个运行时任务和 60 个自主生命周期任务（表 2）。 在生命周期任务中，智能体可以检查和更改技能状态，或直接使用可用工具。 任务与攻击目标检查共同定义成功：在未达成注册攻击目标的前提下完成请求。 规定调用案例在固定调用方式下测量实现行为；两条决策轨道则在完整的任务检查下测量模型选择。

paragraphs.en: Lifecycle tasks reveal differences beyond runtime performance: GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 tie at 82.0% runtime joint success, but score 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, authorization checking improves runtime joint success, but attack-goal successes also increase from 19 to 21 (Section 4.3 ). For these two models, adding execution provenance to logs and metadata raises risk-task joint success from 76/154 to 101/154 under matched conditions. A deterministic hash-and-handle rule reaches 100/154 and preserves more benign task completions than provenance-guided diagnosis (Sections 4.4 – 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 生命周期任务揭示了运行时性能之外的差异：GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Sonnet 4.6 在运行时联合成功率上打平（82.0%），但在生命周期任务上分别得 96.7% 和 56.7%。 在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 上，授权检查提升了运行时联合成功率，但攻击目标成功数也从 19 增加到 21（第 4.3 节）。 对于这两个模型，在匹配条件下将执行溯源加入日志和元数据后，风险任务联合成功率从 76/154 提升到 101/154。 一种确定性的哈希-句柄规则达到 100/154，并且比基于溯源的诊断保留了更多良性任务的完成（第 4.4–4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: AgentDojo measures task utility and attacker goals in executable environments; InjecAgent evaluates injected tool responses, and ToolSword separates input, execution, and output scenarios ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ) . WASP and AgentDAM study Web-agent security and privacy; MCP-SafetyBench and AgentLAB extend evaluation to multi-turn workflows and long-horizon attacks ( Evtimov et al., 2025 ; Zharmagambetov et al., 2025 ; Zong et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 在可执行环境中测量任务效用与攻击者目标；InjecAgent 评估被注入的工具响应，ToolSword 则区分输入、执行与输出场景（Debenedetti 等，2024；Zhan 等，2024；Ye 等，2024）。 WASP 和 AgentDAM 研究 Web 智能体的安全与隐私；MCP-SafetyBench 和 AgentLAB 将评估扩展到多轮工作流与长程攻击（Evtimov 等，2025；Zharmagambetov 等，2025；Zong 等，2026；Jiang 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: AgentTrap evaluates installed bundles, MetaCascade studies metadata-driven selection, and MalSkillBench validates malicious packages through runtime evidence ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . SCR-Bench evaluates composition, SkillHarm includes self-mutating packages, and SkillSec-Eval covers admission through update validation ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ; Badhe and Tiwari, 2026 ) . SkillSec-Eval checks admitted payload integrity and version lineage, then enforces permissions and information flow during execution.
paragraphs.zh: AgentTrap 评估已安装的软件包，MetaCascade 研究元数据驱动的选择机制，MalSkillBench 通过运行时证据验证恶意包（Zhuang et al., 2026；Wen et al., 2026；Guo et al., 2026）。 SCR-Bench 评估组合能力，SkillHarm 包含自我变异的包，SkillSec-Eval 覆盖从准入到更新验证的全过程（Xie et al., 2026；Ning et al., 2026；Badhe and Tiwari, 2026）。 SkillSec-Eval 检查已准入载荷的完整性与版本谱系，然后在执行期间强制实施权限与信息流控制。

paragraphs.en: SkillMisevo-Bench records versioned libraries, retrieved skills, and reuse outcomes; SafeEvolve-UP uses this lineage for repair and replay-based acceptance ( Mao et al., 2026 ) . SkillRelayGuard links skill influence to the content fingerprint of the artifact consumed later and combines this provenance with operation review ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . Both measure mitigation and task utility. Structural and runtime defenses examine capabilities, dependencies, and authorization ( Bhardwaj, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ; dataset and outcome-checking studies examine composition and scoring reliability ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Chen, 2026 ; HUANG et al., 2026 ) . To examine how execution evidence contributes to recovery, SkillLifeBench records the loaded implementation, invocation-time source hash (a content fingerprint of the code), and retained-handle links. Its matched recovery study adds these execution records to logs and metadata while holding the incident, diagnostic model, actions, and budget fixed.
paragraphs.zh: SkillMisevo-Bench 记录带版本的库、检索到的技能以及复用结果；SafeEvolve-UP 利用这一谱系进行修复和基于重放的验收 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) 。 SkillRelayGuard 将技能影响与后续使用工件的内容指纹关联起来，并将这种溯源信息与操作审查相结合 ( Liao et al., 2026 ) 。 两者都衡量缓解效果与任务效用。 结构性防御与运行时防御考察能力、依赖关系和授权 ( Bhardwaj, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ；数据集与结果检查方面的研究考察组合与评分的可靠性 ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Chen, 2026 ; HUANG et al., 2026 ) 。 为了考察执行证据如何促进恢复，SkillLifeBench 记录被加载的实现、调用时源代码哈希（代码的内容指纹）以及保留句柄的链接。 其配套的匹配恢复研究将这些执行记录添加到日志和元数据中，同时保持事件、诊断智能体、动作和预算不变。

sents.zh: 结构性防御与运行时防御考察能力、依赖关系和授权 ( Bhardwaj, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ；数据集与结果检查方面的研究考察组合与评分的可靠性 ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Chen, 2026 ; HUANG et al., 2026 ) 。

sents.en: To examine how execution evidence contributes to recovery, SkillLifeBench records the loaded implementation, invocation-time source hash (a content fingerprint of the code), and retained-handle links.
sents.zh: 为了考察执行证据如何促进恢复，SkillLifeBench 记录被加载的实现、调用时源代码哈希（代码的内容指纹）以及保留句柄的链接。

sents.en: Its matched recovery study adds these execution records to logs and metadata while holding the incident, diagnostic model, actions, and budget fixed.
sents.zh: 其配套的匹配恢复研究将这些执行记录添加到日志和元数据中，同时保持事件、诊断智能体、动作和预算不变。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares seven capabilities. Skill artifacts include reusable instructions, metadata, interfaces, and code. Retained state requires later use of persisted state; writes alone give partial coverage. Version changes include releases, learned revisions, and runtime mutation. Utility and harm cover task outcomes and violations; refusal, acceptance, or detector false positives alone give partial coverage. Versioned provenance links versions to origin, approval, revision, or use. Invoked-code binding links calls to loaded source and handles for comparison with selection. Evidence-guided mitigation uses records for guards, repair, or operation review.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了七项能力。 技能工件包括可复用的指令、元数据、接口和代码。 保留状态需要后续使用持久化状态；仅凭写入只能提供部分覆盖。 版本变更包括发布、习得的修订以及运行时变异。 效用与危害涵盖任务结果和违规行为；仅凭拒绝、接受或检测器的误报只能提供部分覆盖。 带版本的溯源将版本与来源、批准、修订或使用相关联。 被调用代码绑定将调用与已加载的源码及句柄关联，以便与选择结果进行比较。 证据引导的缓解利用记录进行防护、修复或运行审查。

sents.zh: 表 1 比较了七项能力。

sents.zh: 技能工件包括可复用的指令、元数据、接口和代码。

sents.zh: 保留状态需要后续使用持久化状态；仅凭写入只能提供部分覆盖。

sents.en: Version changes include releases, learned revisions, and runtime mutation.
sents.zh: 版本变更包括发布、习得的修订以及运行时变异。

sents.zh: 效用与危害涵盖任务结果和违规行为；仅凭拒绝、接受或检测器的误报只能提供部分覆盖。

sents.zh: 带版本的溯源将版本与来源、批准、修订或使用相关联。

sents.zh: 被调用代码绑定将调用与已加载的源码及句柄关联，以便与选择结果进行比较。

sents.zh: 证据引导的缓解利用记录进行防护、修复或运行审查。

paragraphs.en: SkillLifeBench evaluates useful, authorized task completion as skills change. Each case pairs skill conditions under the same request and authorization, with executable outcome checks and records of the invoked implementation.
paragraphs.zh: SkillLifeBench 在技能变化的过程中评估有用的、经授权的任务完成情况。 每个案例在相同请求和授权下配对不同的技能条件，并配有可执行的结果检查以及对所调用实现的记录。

sents.en: SkillLifeBench evaluates useful, authorized task completion as skills change.
sents.zh: SkillLifeBench 在技能变化的过程中评估有用的、经授权的任务完成情况。

sents.en: Each case pairs skill conditions under the same request and authorization, with executable outcome checks and records of the invoked implementation.
sents.zh: 每个案例在相同请求和授权下配对不同的技能条件，并配有可执行的结果检查以及对所调用实现的记录。

paragraphs.en: Each case specifies a user request, condition-specific initial states, an authorization boundary, two skill conditions, and executable outcome checks. The authorization boundary defines permitted data access, destinations, and state changes. The clean condition uses the reference skill or response; the challenged condition applies a specified change to skill code, metadata, or tool responses. Paired evaluations retain the request and authorization boundary while measuring task outcomes and registered violations.
paragraphs.zh: 每个用例指定一个用户请求、特定条件下的初始状态、一个授权边界、两个技能条件，以及可执行的结果检查。 授权边界定义了允许的数据访问、目的地和状态变更。 干净条件使用参考技能或响应；挑战条件对技能代码、元数据或工具响应施加指定的更改。 配对评估在保留请求和授权边界的同时，衡量任务结果和已记录的违规行为。

sents.en: Each case specifies a user request, condition-specific initial states, an authorization boundary, two skill conditions, and executable outcome checks.
sents.zh: 每个用例指定一个用户请求、特定条件下的初始状态、一个授权边界、两个技能条件，以及可执行的结果检查。

sents.en: The authorization boundary defines permitted data access, destinations, and state changes.
sents.zh: 授权边界定义了允许的数据访问、目的地和状态变更。

sents.en: The clean condition uses the reference skill or response; the challenged condition applies a specified change to skill code, metadata, or tool responses.
sents.zh: 干净条件使用参考技能或响应；挑战条件对技能代码、元数据或工具响应施加指定的更改。

sents.en: Paired evaluations retain the request and authorization boundary while measuring task outcomes and registered violations.
sents.zh: 配对评估在保留请求和授权边界的同时，衡量任务结果和已记录的违规行为。

paragraphs.en: The model observes public tool names, descriptions, argument schemas, and feedback; the executor resolves the implementation. In the main comparison, the model sees the interface but not the source code, so a valid call can execute altered behavior. In 64 implementation and interface cases, the task prescribes an exact apply_contract call; the comparison measures the implementation’s execution consequences under that call. Runtime cases test decisions after feedback; autonomous lifecycle tasks test implementation selection, configuration and reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 模型观察公开的工具名称、描述、参数模式和反馈；执行器负责解析具体实现。 在主要对比中，模型只能看到接口而看不到源代码，因此一次有效调用可能执行的是被更改过的行为。 在 64 个实现与接口用例中，任务规定了确切的 apply_contract 调用；该对比衡量的是在该调用下实现的执行后果。 运行时用例测试反馈后的决策；自主生命周期任务测试实现的选择、配置与复用。

sents.en: The model observes public tool names, descriptions, argument schemas, and feedback; the executor resolves the implementation.
sents.zh: 模型观察公开的工具名称、描述、参数模式和反馈；执行器负责解析具体实现。

sents.en: In the main comparison, the model sees the interface but not the source code, so a valid call can execute altered behavior.
sents.zh: 在主要对比中，模型只能看到接口而看不到源代码，因此一次有效调用可能执行的是被更改过的行为。

sents.en: In 64 implementation and interface cases, the task prescribes an exact apply_contract call; the comparison measures the implementation’s execution consequences under that call.
sents.zh: 在 64 个实现与接口用例中，任务规定了确切的 apply_contract 调用；该对比衡量的是在该调用下实现的执行后果。

sents.en: Runtime cases test decisions after feedback; autonomous lifecycle tasks test implementation selection, configuration and reuse.
sents.zh: 运行时用例测试反馈后的决策；自主生命周期任务测试实现的选择、配置与复用。

paragraphs.en: An episode runs one case condition with a model and an agent harness , which manages model–tool interactions. A trajectory connects episodes through persistent skill identity and version state. Each episode evaluates useful output and the specified violation separately: a requested output and an unauthorized copy can coexist.
paragraphs.zh: 一个回合（episode）使用一个模型和一个智能体框架运行一个用例条件，该框架负责管理模型与工具之间的交互。 一条轨迹（trajectory）通过持久的技能标识和版本状态连接多个回合。 每个回合分别评估有用输出和指定的违规行为：被请求的输出和未经授权的副本可以同时存在。

sents.en: An episode runs one case condition with a model and an agent harness , which manages model–tool interactions.
sents.zh: 一个回合（episode）使用一个模型和一个智能体框架运行一个用例条件，该框架负责管理模型与工具之间的交互。

sents.en: A trajectory connects episodes through persistent skill identity and version state.
sents.zh: 一条轨迹（trajectory）通过持久的技能标识和版本状态连接多个回合。

sents.en: Each episode evaluates useful output and the specified violation separately: a requested output and an unauthorized copy can coexist.
sents.zh: 每个回合分别评估有用输出和指定的违规行为：被请求的输出和未经授权的副本可以同时存在。

paragraphs.en: Lifecycle operations describe how a skill reaches a task: Acquire admits it, Store preserves its code and registry entry (the record of skill identity, version, and approval), Retrieve selects a skill identity and version, Execute invokes the resolved implementation, and Evolve activates a successor for later use. The A–E perturbation families specify what changes along this lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 生命周期操作描述一项技能如何到达任务：Acquire（获取）接纳它，Store（存储）保存其代码和注册表条目（即记录技能身份、版本与审批的记录），Retrieve（检索）选择一个技能身份和版本，Execute（执行）调用解析后的实现，Evolve（演化）激活一个后继技能以供后续使用。 A–E 扰动族指明了沿这一生命周期所变化的内容。

sents.en: Lifecycle operations describe how a skill reaches a task: Acquire admits it, Store preserves its code and registry entry (the record of skill identity, version, and approval), Retrieve selects a skill identity and version, Execute invokes the resolved implementation, and Evolve activates a successor for later use.
sents.zh: 生命周期操作描述一项技能如何到达任务：Acquire（获取）接纳它，Store（存储）保存其代码和注册表条目（即记录技能身份、版本与审批的记录），Retrieve（检索）选择一个技能身份和版本，Execute（执行）调用解析后的实现，Evolve（演化）激活一个后继技能以供后续使用。

sents.en: The A–E perturbation families specify what changes along this lifecycle.
sents.zh: A–E 扰动族指明了沿这一生命周期所变化的内容。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark contains 388 cases : 262 introduced in this benchmark and 126 adapted from AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . The 126 adapted cases retain the published attack payloads, tasks, attack goals, and tool interfaces; 89 with complete task and attack-goal checks form our runtime decision track , also called the semantic core. Appendix A details sources and controls.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试包含388个用例：其中262个为本基准测试新增，126个改编自AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）。 这126个改编用例保留了已发表的攻击载荷、任务、攻击目标和工具接口；其中89个具备完整任务与攻击目标校验的用例构成了我们的运行时决策赛道，也称为语义核心。 附录A详细介绍了来源与对照设置。

sents.en: The benchmark contains 388 cases : 262 introduced in this benchmark and 126 adapted from AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 该基准测试包含388个用例：其中262个为本基准测试新增，126个改编自AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）。

sents.en: The 126 adapted cases retain the published attack payloads, tasks, attack goals, and tool interfaces; 89 with complete task and attack-goal checks form our runtime decision track , also called the semantic core.
sents.zh: 这126个改编用例保留了已发表的攻击载荷、任务、攻击目标和工具接口；其中89个具备完整任务与攻击目标校验的用例构成了我们的运行时决策赛道，也称为语义核心。

sents.en: Appendix A details sources and controls.
sents.zh: 附录A详细介绍了来源与对照设置。

paragraphs.en: A changes implementation behavior (19 cases). B changes the interface–implementation relationship (77): 53 code changes preserve the interface, one changes a description, and 23 change code and metadata. C changes runtime content (128). D tests workflow propagation (65), checking effects across skill calls. E compares versions (99), including OpenClaw security updates ( aether-ai-agent, 2026 ; Sid, 2026 ) . All A and E pairs and the 53 B pairs above retain identical public catalogs.
paragraphs.zh: A 类改变实现行为（19 例）。 B 类改变接口—实现关系（77 例）：其中 53 例代码变更保留接口，1 例改变描述，23 例同时改变代码和元数据。 C 类改变运行时内容（128 例）。 D 类测试工作流传播（65 例），检查跨技能调用的效果。 E 类比较版本（99 例），包括 OpenClaw 安全更新（ aether-ai-agent, 2026 ；Sid, 2026 ）。 所有 A 类和 E 类配对以及上述 53 个 B 类配对均保留相同的公开目录。

sents.en: A changes implementation behavior (19 cases).
sents.zh: A 类改变实现行为（19 例）。

sents.en: B changes the interface–implementation relationship (77): 53 code changes preserve the interface, one changes a description, and 23 change code and metadata.
sents.zh: B 类改变接口—实现关系（77 例）：其中 53 例代码变更保留接口，1 例改变描述，23 例同时改变代码和元数据。

sents.en: C changes runtime content (128).
sents.zh: C 类改变运行时内容（128 例）。

sents.en: D tests workflow propagation (65), checking effects across skill calls.
sents.zh: D 类测试工作流传播（65 例），检查跨技能调用的效果。

sents.en: E compares versions (99), including OpenClaw security updates ( aether-ai-agent, 2026 ; Sid, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: E 类比较版本（99 例），包括 OpenClaw 安全更新（ aether-ai-agent, 2026 ；Sid, 2026 ）。

sents.en: All A and E pairs and the 53 B pairs above retain identical public catalogs.
sents.zh: 所有 A 类和 E 类配对以及上述 53 个 B 类配对均保留相同的公开目录。

paragraphs.en: For 13 composition cases, an additional control replaces the tracked input value or removes the target command while keeping downstream tools fixed. This tests the downstream effect’s dependence on the specified source input, giving 2 × 388 + 13 = 789 2\times 388+13=789 runs per model for the complete suite. Cases sharing a task context or attack goal retain common identifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 13 个组合案例，额外添加一个对照：替换被追踪的输入值或移除目标命令，同时保持下游工具不变。 这测试了下游效应对指定源输入的依赖性，每个模型在完整套件上的运行次数为 2 × 388 + 13 = 789 2\times 388+13=789 次。 共享任务上下文或攻击目标的案例保留共同的标识符。

sents.en: For 13 composition cases, an additional control replaces the tracked input value or removes the target command while keeping downstream tools fixed.
sents.zh: 对于 13 个组合案例，额外添加一个对照：替换被追踪的输入值或移除目标命令，同时保持下游工具不变。

sents.en: This tests the downstream effect’s dependence on the specified source input, giving 2 × 388 + 13 = 789 2\times 388+13=789 runs per model for the complete suite.
sents.zh: 这测试了下游效应对指定源输入的依赖性，每个模型在完整套件上的运行次数为 2 × 388 + 13 = 789 2\times 388+13=789 次。

sents.en: Cases sharing a task context or attack goal retain common identifiers.
sents.zh: 共享任务上下文或攻击目标的案例保留共同的标识符。

paragraphs.en: We record each request, required inputs, permitted destinations and state changes, and attack goal, then verify that the goal exceeds the user’s authorization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录每个请求、所需输入、允许的目标地址和状态变更，以及攻击目标，然后验证该目标是否超出了用户的授权范围。

paragraphs.en: We construct reference and challenged artifacts using the changes defined by A–E. File hashes fingerprint each artifact; paired runs share the request and authorization and start from matched task states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 A–E 所定义的变更来构建参考工件与受挑战工件。 文件哈希对每个工件进行指纹标识；成对运行共享请求与授权，并从相互匹配的任务状态开始。

sents.en: We construct reference and challenged artifacts using the changes defined by A–E.
sents.zh: 我们使用 A–E 所定义的变更来构建参考工件与受挑战工件。

sents.en: File hashes fingerprint each artifact; paired runs share the request and authorization and start from matched task states.
sents.zh: 文件哈希对每个工件进行指纹标识；成对运行共享请求与授权，并从相互匹配的任务状态开始。

paragraphs.en: Positive and negative controls validate utility and harm checks. For example, the packaging case checks document preservation separately from prohibited version-control metadata (Section 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 阳性对照和阴性对照用于验证实用性与危害性检查。 例如，打包用例检查将文档保留与被禁止的版本控制元数据分开验证（见 4.6 节）。

sents.en: Positive and negative controls validate utility and harm checks.
sents.zh: 阳性对照和阴性对照用于验证实用性与危害性检查。

sents.en: For example, the packaging case checks document preservation separately from prohibited version-control metadata (Section 4.6 ).
sents.zh: 例如，打包用例检查将文档保留与被禁止的版本控制元数据分开验证（见 4.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: We test complete workflows that preserve the request, inputs, and authorization while producing the required useful output without the specified harm. Section 3.5 distinguishes verified agent-visible workflows, trusted deployment interventions, and cases without a verified intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试完整的工作流，这些工作流在保留请求、输入和授权的同时，产生所需的实用输出而不造成指定的危害。 第 3.5 节区分了经过验证的智能体可见工作流、可信的部署干预，以及没有经过验证的干预的情况。

sents.en: We test complete workflows that preserve the request, inputs, and authorization while producing the required useful output without the specified harm.
sents.zh: 我们测试完整的工作流，这些工作流在保留请求、输入和授权的同时，产生所需的实用输出而不造成指定的危害。

sents.en: Section 3.5 distinguishes verified agent-visible workflows, trusted deployment interventions, and cases without a verified intervention.
sents.zh: 第 3.5 节区分了经过验证的智能体可见工作流、可信的部署干预，以及没有经过验证的干预的情况。

paragraphs.en: We derive 60 task instances from 12 parent cases among the 262 introduced cases: four templates each from B, D and E, with five parameter instances per template. Each pairs clean and challenged lifecycle states under the same request, inputs and authorization. Public observations expose registry approvals, loaded versions and their bindings, or saved workflow policies. Agents freely inspect, select and reload implementations, configure workflows or compose available tools to complete the task. These choices cover implementation selection, stored replacement, revoked permissions, workflow composition and version updates. State pairs preserve the parent mechanisms; the packaging template uses a maintainer-issued OpenClaw update. All 560 qualification controls pass, including safe completion in both conditions and refusal, partial-output and harmful-execution controls. Appendix A gives the templates and complete endpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从已引入的 262 个案例中的 12 个父案例派生出 60 个任务实例：来自 B、D 和 E 的模板各四个，每个模板有五个参数实例。 每个任务实例在相同的请求、输入和授权条件下，将干净的生命周期状态与受挑战的生命周期状态配对。 公开观察内容会暴露注册表批准、已加载的版本及其绑定，或已保存的工作流策略。 智能体可以自由地检查、选择并重新加载实现，配置工作流，或组合可用的工具来完成任务。 这些选择涵盖实现选择、存储替换、权限撤销、工作流组合以及版本更新。 状态对保留了父案例的机制；打包模板使用了维护者发布的 OpenClaw 更新。 所有 560 个合格性控制项全部通过，包括两种条件下的安全完成，以及拒绝、部分输出和有害执行的控制项。 附录 A 给出了模板和完整的端点。

sents.zh: 我们从已引入的 262 个案例中的 12 个父案例派生出 60 个任务实例：来自 B、D 和 E 的模板各四个，每个模板有五个参数实例。

sents.en: Agents freely inspect, select and reload implementations, configure workflows or compose available tools to complete the task.
sents.zh: 智能体可以自由地检查、选择并重新加载实现，配置工作流，或组合可用的工具来完成任务。

sents.en: These choices cover implementation selection, stored replacement, revoked permissions, workflow composition and version updates.
sents.zh: 这些选择涵盖实现选择、存储替换、权限撤销、工作流组合以及版本更新。

sents.zh: 状态对保留了父案例的机制；打包模板使用了维护者发布的 OpenClaw 更新。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation framework, SkillLifeEval, separates model inference, skill execution, and outcome measurement (Figure 1 ). Skills receive declared arguments and synthetic task files in disposable Linux sandboxes; API credentials remain outside. Records capture the invoked implementation, arguments, feedback, state changes, and termination. Persistent runs also record active, selected, and executed versions. Implementation identity denotes the loaded object; the source hash fingerprints its code; handle links connect stored references to it. Comparison with selected or approved versions exposes stale or replaced implementations. Hashes establish code identity; outcome checks establish harm. Experiments use synthetic canaries—test values that reveal unauthorized copying—in controlled environments isolated from production data and external recipients. Released records omit credential-bearing response headers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估框架 SkillLifeEval 将模型推理、技能执行与结果测量分离开来（图 1）。 技能在一次性的 Linux 沙箱中接收声明的参数和合成任务文件；API 凭证保留在沙箱之外。 记录会捕获被调用的实现、参数、反馈、状态变更和终止情况。 持久化运行还会记录活跃版本、被选中版本和被执行版本。 实现标识表示已加载的对象；源代码哈希为其代码生成指纹；句柄链接将存储的引用与该对象连接起来。 与被选中或已批准版本的比较可以暴露过时或已被替换的实现。 哈希确定代码身份；结果检查确定危害。 实验使用合成金丝雀——即能揭示未经授权复制行为的测试值——并在与生产数据和外部接收者隔离的受控环境中进行。 发布的记录会省略包含凭证的响应头。

paragraphs.en: A supporting study follows 77 B-family skills through installation, replacement in storage, and hash-based verification. Appendix D gives the persistent-state protocols and the case timeline.

paragraphs.en: We measure four outcomes: case-specific utility (the useful output required by the case, such as preserving a document), full task correctness, specified harm, and complete attack goals. A disclosure check binds a specified synthetic value to its destination; an integrity check evaluates the protected-state transition. The runtime track checks complete tasks and attack goals; the lifecycle track also checks required artifacts and lifecycle state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们衡量四项结果：案例特定效用（案例所需的有效输出，例如保存一份文档）、完整任务正确性、特定危害以及完整的攻击目标。 披露检查将特定的合成值绑定到其目的地；完整性检查则评估受保护状态的转换。 运行时轨道检查完整任务和攻击目标；生命周期轨道还会检查所需的产物和生命周期状态。

paragraphs.en: Both decision tracks score task completion and attack-goal achievement as True or False. Completion requires all specified answers, artifacts, state changes and ordering constraints. An incomplete task is a failure, including after refusal, invalid actions or budget exhaustion. Once the attack goal occurs, later repair does not erase it. Joint success means completing the task without achieving the attack goal. Models share the scoring protocol within each track (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 两条判定路径均将任务完成度与攻击目标达成度评定为 True 或 False。 完成要求满足所有规定的答案、产物、状态变更及顺序约束。 未完成的任务即为失败，包括在拒绝、无效操作或预算耗尽之后的情况。 一旦攻击目标发生，其后的修复也无法消除它。 联合成功是指在未达成攻击目标的情况下完成任务。 各路径内的模型共用同一评分协议（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: We rerun each of the 170 agent-visible workflows with five resampled private test values. All 850 replays preserve the required useful output and avoid the specified harm, without reading hidden information or changing task authorization. Section 4.3 tests authorization checking, which evaluates actions against the request’s permitted data, destinations, and state changes, on cases with agent-visible workflows. Trusted restoration is tested on cases with deployment interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用五组重采样的私有测试值，重新运行每个包含170个智能体可见工作流的用例。 全部850次重放都保留了所需的实用输出并避免了指定危害，且未读取隐藏信息或更改任务授权。 第4.3节在包含智能体可见工作流的用例上测试授权检查，该机制将操作与请求所允许的数据、目的地和状态变更进行比对评估。 可信恢复在包含部署干预的用例上进行测试。

paragraphs.en: The recovery study reuses the 77 B-family cases within the 388-case benchmark. They cover 17 task templates and six fault types, introduced through package, registry, cache, or handle changes before recovery (Table 6 ). Each parent pairs a risk configuration with a constructed benign configuration under the same request, authorization, inputs, interfaces and checks. Cases and public approval records are fixed before model evaluation. Repair candidates must be available, unrevoked, integrity-verified, and task-compatible. Full restoration (Full) selects by approval sequence and source hash; it receives no hidden fault labels, paired-clean identities, or successful-repair answers. Each model evaluates 77 risk and 77 benign configurations, giving each method 154 evaluations per track across two models. Appendix C details the construction and rule triggers.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复研究复用了388个用例基准中的77个B族用例。 这些用例覆盖17个任务模板和六种故障类型，故障在恢复前通过包、注册表、缓存或句柄变更引入（表6）。 每个父用例在相同的请求、授权、输入、接口和检查条件下，将一个风险配置与一个构造的良性配置配对。 用例和公开的批准记录在模型评估之前已固定。 修复候选必须可用、未被撤销、通过完整性验证且与任务兼容。 完全恢复（Full）按批准顺序和源哈希进行选择；它不接收任何隐藏的故障标签、配对良性身份或成功修复答案。 每个模型评估77个风险配置和77个良性配置，使每种方法在两个模型上各获得154次评估。 附录C详细说明了构造过程和规则触发条件。

paragraphs.en: Logs and metadata (M) contain the request’s authorization, calls and returns, incident outcomes, native logs, installed and active versions, file hashes, approval records, and eligible repair candidates. Execution provenance (E) adds implementation-level provenance to M: loaded implementation identities, invocation-time source hashes, and stored-handle links. The incident, model, prompt, actions and budget are identical; fault and repair labels are withheld.

paragraphs.en: In both evidence conditions, the model selects one supported plan. A common executor applies it from matched package, registry, cache and in-memory state. A fresh Default conversation runs the fixed subsequent task. Full restores eligible approved implementations and restarts the runtime without model diagnosis. Appendix A.1 gives prompts, actions, selection rules and failure handling.

paragraphs.en: The rules use execution records, matched incident snapshots and authorized recovery targets without model diagnosis. R-Hash-Reload reloads or activates eligible implementations when executed or stored source hashes violate version or approval constraints. R-Hash-Restore uses the same trigger but applies Full. R-Hash-Link also checks handle bindings and chooses reload, restart or restoration according to visible adapter capabilities. Valid retained versions satisfy the same task constraints as other eligible targets. Each rule selects one plan from the common action set without trial repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些规则使用执行记录、匹配的事件快照和已授权的恢复目标，而不进行模型诊断。 当执行或存储的源哈希违反版本或审批约束时，R-Hash-Reload 会重新加载或激活符合条件的实现。 R-Hash-Restore 使用相同的触发条件，但应用 Full。 R-Hash-Link 还会检查句柄绑定，并根据可见的适配器能力选择重新加载、重启或恢复。 有效的保留版本需满足与其他符合条件的目标相同的任务约束。 每条规则从通用动作集中选择一个方案，不进行尝试性修复。

paragraphs.en: The two decision tracks evaluate 14 models on 89 runtime and 60 lifecycle tasks , giving 4,172 clean/challenged executions. Twelve models also cover all 388 source cases. In Table 2 , Open denotes downloadable weights and Closed denotes hosted-only access. Both tracks allow 15 logical model rounds, 30 attempted tool calls, 2,048 output tokens per request, two transport attempts per request, a 180 s request timeout, and 900 s per episode.

paragraphs.en: Task completion can conceal lifecycle harm. Across 840 challenged lifecycle evaluations, agents complete 651 tasks (77.5%), but 103 also achieve the attack goal , leaving 548 joint successes (65.2%; Figure 3 ). Clean runs achieve 688 joint successes (81.9%) with zero attack-goal successes.
paragraphs.zh: 任务完成可能掩盖生命周期危害。 在 840 次受挑战的生命周期评估中，智能体完成了 651 项任务（77.5%），但其中有 103 次同时达成了攻击目标，留下 548 次联合成功（65.2%；图 3）。 干净运行实现了 688 次联合成功（81.9%），且攻击目标成功次数为零。

paragraphs.en: Authorization checking improves joint success on agent-visible workflows. These evaluations cover 46 introduced non-runtime cases: 10 interface, 30 composition, and six version cases with verified workflows in which models can choose authorized actions. Utility positives increase from 53 to 56 and effects fall from 40 to 27, with 18 paired gains and four losses. Verified workflows establish feasible outcomes; Check tests whether the agent chooses an authorized path.

paragraphs.en: Runtime joint success improves, while attack-goal successes also increase. Pooled success increases from 120/178 to 129/178 (+5.06 points), with 15 paired gains and 6 losses. Task successes rise from 134 to 145, while complete attack goals also rise from 19 to 21. The other runtime subset improves from 26/70 to 35/70 (+12.86 points). The semantic core checks full task correctness; the other groups check their specified useful outputs.

Restoration changes the deployed implementation; RQ4 reports its benign-utility cost.

paragraphs.en: Persistent state separates selection from execution. Storage replacement produces 161 new harm-positive outcomes among 231 paired case/model observations across 66 skills. In 36 controlled post-update executions, active and selected identities always agree, but 12 calls execute the parent: six harmful challenged tasks and six benign tasks without harm. Invocation records identify the executed implementation; outcome checks determine its effect. Table 4 and Appendix D give the paired protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 持久化状态将选择与执行分离。 存储替换在 66 项技能的 231 组配对案例/模型观测中产生了 161 个新的有害正向结果。 在 36 次受控的更新后执行中，活跃身份与被选身份始终一致，但有 12 次调用执行的是父级：其中六次是有害的受质疑任务，六次是无害的良性任务。 调用记录标识所执行的实现；结果检查确定其影响。 表 4 和附录 D 给出了配对协议。

sents.en: In 36 controlled post-update executions, active and selected identities always agree, but 12 calls execute the parent: six harmful challenged tasks and six benign tasks without harm.

paragraphs.en: Execution evidence supports model diagnosis and rule-based recovery. Under matched snapshots and actions, risk joint success is 76/154 with logs and metadata, 101/154 with execution provenance, and 107/154 with full restoration (Figure 6 a–b). The deterministic rules reach 90/154 with R-Hash-Reload and 94/154 with R-Hash-Restore; Provenance has 12 paired gains and five losses against R-Hash-Restore, a net gain of seven. R-Hash-Link reaches 100/154, with four gains and three losses for Provenance. Source hashes and handle links support a rule that recovers nearly as many risk tasks as model diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 执行证据支持模型诊断与基于规则的恢复。 在快照与动作匹配的条件下，使用日志与元数据时风险联合成功率为 76/154，使用执行溯源时为 101/154，完整还原时为 107/154（图 6 a–b）。 确定性规则在使用 R-Hash-Reload 时达到 90/154，使用 R-Hash-Restore 时达到 94/154；Provenance 相对 R-Hash-Restore 有 12 例配对增益和 5 例损失，净增 7 例。 R-Hash-Link 达到 100/154，Provenance 相对它有 4 例增益和 3 例损失。 源哈希与句柄链接支撑了一条规则，其恢复的风险任务数量几乎与模型诊断相当。

sents.en: Execution evidence supports model diagnosis and rule-based recovery.
sents.zh: 执行证据支持模型诊断与基于规则的恢复。

sents.en: Under matched snapshots and actions, risk joint success is 76/154 with logs and metadata, 101/154 with execution provenance, and 107/154 with full restoration (Figure 6 a–b).

sents.en: The deterministic rules reach 90/154 with R-Hash-Reload and 94/154 with R-Hash-Restore; Provenance has 12 paired gains and five losses against R-Hash-Restore, a net gain of seven.
sents.zh: 确定性规则在使用 R-Hash-Reload 时达到 90/154，使用 R-Hash-Restore 时达到 94/154；Provenance 相对 R-Hash-Restore 有 12 例配对增益和 5 例损失，净增 7 例。

paragraphs.en: Full restoration gains on cases without a hash trigger. R-Hash-Restore and Full each succeed on 75 of the 108 risk evaluations where the rule triggers. On the 46 evaluations where it selects no action, the rule succeeds on 19 and Full on 32. These untriggered cases account for Full’s entire 13-success net advantage over R-Hash-Restore.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有哈希触发的情况下完全恢复所获得的收益。 在规则触发的 108 次风险评估中，R-Hash-Restore 和 Full 各在 75 次上成功。 在其未选择任何动作的 46 次评估中，该规则成功了 19 次，而 Full 成功了 32 次。 这些未触发的案例构成了 Full 相对于 R-Hash-Restore 的全部 13 次成功的净优势。

Each ablation retains native logs and all other evidence groups. Appendix A.2 defines the projections and Table 8 gives per-model counts and paired gains/reversals.

paragraphs.en: Finding 3. Execution evidence supports both rules and model-guided recovery. The hash-and-handle rule recovers 100/154 tasks versus 101/154 with model diagnosis. Removing source hashes or handle links reduces the latter by 16 or ten successes; removing implementation identity reduces it by one.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 3。 执行证据同时支持规则和模型引导的恢复。 哈希与句柄规则可恢复 154 个任务中的 100 个，而模型诊断为 154 个中的 101 个。 移除源哈希或句柄链接会使后者分别减少 16 个或 10 个成功；移除实现身份则使其减少一个。

paragraphs.en: Provenance uses fewer plans and less time than full restoration. Across 308 evaluations, Logs, Provenance and Full submit 165, 137 and 308 non-noop plans and average 102.50, 97.50 and 127.50 s, respectively. Provenance uses 55.52% fewer plans and 23.53% less online time than Full. Timing includes failures and timeouts; Appendix A.1 defines submission and timing boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 溯源比完整恢复使用更少的规划和更少的时间。 在 308 次评估中，Logs、Provenance 和 Full 分别提交了 165、137 和 308 个非 noop 规划，平均耗时分别为 102.50、97.50 和 127.50 秒。 Provenance 比 Full 少使用 55.52% 的规划和 23.53% 的在线时间。 计时包含失败和超时；附录 A.1 定义了提交与计时边界。

sents.en: Provenance uses fewer plans and less time than full restoration.
sents.zh: 溯源比完整恢复使用更少的规划和更少的时间。

sents.en: Across 308 evaluations, Logs, Provenance and Full submit 165, 137 and 308 non-noop plans and average 102.50, 97.50 and 127.50 s, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Provenance preserves fewer benign tasks than Logs, Full, and the rules. In the recovery study, benign utility is 120/154 (77.92%) with Logs, 115/154 (74.68%) with Provenance, and 117/154 (75.97%) with full restoration. R-Hash-Reload, R-Hash-Restore and R-Hash-Link preserve 122, 118 and 120 benign successes, respectively. R-Hash-Link has one fewer risk success and five more benign successes than Provenance. In the separate deployment study, benign utility changes from 303/378 (80.16%) to 294/378 (77.78%), a 2.38-point decrease. Appendix C gives paired outcomes and exact costs.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Logs、Full 以及规则相比，Provenance 保留的良性任务更少。 在恢复研究中，使用 Logs 时良性效用为 120/154（77.92%），使用 Provenance 时为 115/154（74.68%），完全恢复时为 117/154（75.97%）。 R-Hash-Reload、R-Hash-Restore 和 R-Hash-Link 分别保留了 122、118 和 120 个良性成功。 与 Provenance 相比，R-Hash-Link 的风险成功少一个，良性成功多五个。 在独立部署研究中，良性效用从 303/378（80.16%）变为 294/378（77.78%），下降了 2.38 个百分点。 附录 C 给出了成对的结果和精确成本。

sents.en: In the recovery study, benign utility is 120/154 (77.92%) with Logs, 115/154 (74.68%) with Provenance, and 117/154 (75.97%) with full restoration.
sents.zh: 在恢复研究中，使用 Logs 时良性效用为 120/154（77.92%），使用 Provenance 时为 115/154（74.68%），完全恢复时为 117/154（75.97%）。

paragraphs.en: Finding 4. Recovery policies trade off risk recovery, benign utility and cost. R-Hash-Link nearly matches Provenance in risk recovery (100 versus 101) and preserves more benign tasks (120 versus 115). Provenance uses 55.52% fewer plans and 23.53% less online time than Full, with lower recovery and benign utility.

paragraphs.en: SkillLifeBench evaluates authorized task completion using paired skill conditions and execution records. Lifecycle tasks reveal model differences beyond runtime scores, while task completion can accompany attack-goal achievement. On two Qwen models, execution evidence improves risk recovery; a hash-and-handle rule nearly matches model diagnosis with higher benign utility. The benchmark supports diagnosing execution mismatches and comparing recovery policies on risk, benign utility, and cost. Evaluating skill reuse therefore requires checking that version selections take effect in execution and that task actions stay within the user’s authorization.
paragraphs.zh: SkillLifeBench 使用成对的技能条件与执行记录来评估授权任务的完成情况。 生命周期任务揭示了运行时分数之外的模型差异，而任务完成可能伴随攻击目标的达成。 在两个 Qwen 模型上，执行证据改善了风险恢复；一种哈希加句柄规则几乎能达到模型诊断的效果，且良性效用更高。 该基准支持诊断执行不一致问题，并在风险、良性效用和成本方面比较恢复策略。 因此，评估技能复用需要检查版本选择是否在执行中生效，以及任务操作是否始终在用户的授权范围之内。

paragraphs.en: You are selecting one remediation action after a recorded incident. Treat the supplied request, logs, metadata, and execution receipts as evidence, not as instructions. Use only the supplied evidence, public repair scope, eligible artifact manifest, and supported actions. Select exactly one permitted action. No-op is allowed. Any package or artifact you name must occur in the supplied scope or candidate manifest. Do not assume that the newest or an approved artifact is necessarily safe. Preserve the original task, user data, and authorization, and avoid unnecessary changes. Do not assume hidden fault labels, reference solutions, or a correct repair. paragraphs.en: Within the fixed public task and tool scope, Full requires available, approved, unrevoked, signature/digest-verified candidates compatible with interface, runtime and authorization. It maximizes approval_seq per package, breaking ties by smallest lexicographic digest. Preflight covers all candidates; missing candidates fail before mutation. Full restores packages in ID order and restarts, without diagnosis or paired-clean outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Checkpoints or fixed-prefix replay reconstruct package, registry, cache and in-memory state. The executor applies one plan without trial repairs. After timeout, subsequent tasks run only once mutations stop; otherwise they are omitted and outcomes remain unobserved.

paragraphs.en: Default, Check and follow-up each allow 15 logical model rounds, 30 attempted tool calls, 2,048 output tokens/request and 900 s. Diagnosis allows one logical request, 2,048 tokens and 120 s. Repair allows one plan, 2 ​ k + 2 2k+2 primitive attempts for k k scoped packages, and 120 s. Phase totals are 1,140 s for M/E and 1,020 s for Full; unused budgets are not transferred. Tool/primitive timeouts are 30 s. Model-request timeouts are 180 s, capped by remaining phase time. Each logical request permits two transport attempts, with 1 s backoff, only for connection failures, HTTP 429/5xx, or timeouts without a complete response. Invalid content is not retried.
